title: Nsec-free Bahia operator CLI signing
observed_behavior: The operator CLI required a local Nostr private key and the relay pool could sign NIP-42 AUTH only with that private key.
intended_behavior: Operator ContextVM commands and relay AUTH challenges can be signed by a persistent NIP-46 session while the CLI holds no operator identity private key.
scope: pkg/client operator signer injection and lifecycle
security_properties: bunker URI and client session key are required as a pair
NIP-46 and local identity-key inputs are mutually exclusive
operator identity private key never enters the NIP-46 client configuration
